jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for expert advisory committee members, not a paid role — it seeks established experts in the field and is effectively a volunteer/advisory position, not a genuine paid vacancy for an early-career candidate. It also targets senior domain experts, which is a level mismatch, so it fails the paid-role gate despite the human-rights subject matter.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.reason: A "Manager" title with essential requirements of at least 2 years' B2B sales experience, proven double-digit account-growth track record, and Salesforce/pricing expertise — all clearly beyond an early-career profile and well outside the candidate's background. It also requires fluency in a business language of the Shenzhen region (i.e. Chinese), which the candidate does not hold. Sales/account management is outside the candidate's research and policy interest zones.

jobs.title: LRQA Sub-contractor
jobs.reason: Requires being a qualified QEHS auditor certified in ISO 9001/14001/45001 standards, a technical qualification the candidate does not hold. The role is a management-systems assessment contractor position with no connection to the candidate's research, policy or international-affairs profile.

jobs.title: Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: Ineligible on multiple hard grounds: it is a "Lead" role requiring 3–5 years' industry experience, requires an engineering degree and the ability to audit in French (beyond the candidate's B1). The GHG-verification/auditing work is also entirely outside the candidate's research and policy profile.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Adviser
jobs.reason: Senior title implying substantial post-qualification experience, and a legal-adviser role that requires a legal qualification the candidate does not hold. The accountability/justice mission is a perfect interest match, but the level and qualification are unmet essentials.

jobs.title: Advisory Board Member
jobs.reason: An advisory board seat is a senior, expert-level appointment far beyond an early-career candidate, and typically not a paid entry role. The field fits, but the seniority is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Internship - Speculative Opportunities
jobs.reason: Internship / speculative postings are excluded as a matter of policy, regardless of field fit.

jobs.title: Legal Adviser
jobs.reason: A legal-adviser role requires a legal qualification / admission to practise that the candidate does not hold (no qualifying law degree / GDL / SQE). The international-justice subject is a perfect match, but the qualification is an unmet essential.

jobs.title: OSINT Trainer and Safety Protocol Developer
jobs.reason: A "Trainer" role implies demonstrated OSINT training expertise and security-protocol design experience the candidate lacks, making it a senior/specialist rather than entry-level position. OSINT for accountability is a core interest zone, but the role expects an established practitioner able to train others.

jobs.title: Speculative Application
jobs.reason: A speculative / talent-pool posting with no concrete vacancy is excluded as a matter of policy.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an unpaid advisory committee, not a genuine paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists to advise a project, which the candidate is not, and there is no salaried vacancy. The human-rights and securitisation subject is a strong interest match, but the role's nature (expert advisory, no pay) disqualifies it.
